title: 9-Day Grand Egypt Journey with Nile Cruise
metaDescription: Discover Cairo, Aswan and Luxor on a 9-day Egypt journey combining the Pyramids, legendary temples and a relaxing cruise along the Nile.
breadcrumb: Explore Our Travel Destinations & Multi-Country Tours
9-Day Grand Egypt Journey with Nile Cruise
summary:
The 9-Day Cairo, Aswan & Luxor Tour pairs Cairo’s major archaeological sites with a four-night Nile cruise traveling south from Luxor to Aswan. Begin at the Pyramids of Giza and Saqqara before flying to Luxor, where Karnak Temple and the Valley of the Kings introduce ancient Thebes. During the cruise, visits to Edfu and Kom Ombo break up the journey before reaching Aswan, giving you four nights to experience the Nile rather than treating it simply as transportation between cities.
The journey operates year-round and includes selected 5-star hotels, a 4-night Nile cruise, daily breakfast, domestic flights, English-speaking local guides, transfers and scheduled sightseeing.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Cairo
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Cairo International Airport. Meet and transfer to your hotel in Cairo.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Tour to Pyramids, Memphis & Saqqara
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the colossal statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to visit the famous Step Pyramid of Djoser. Later, explore the Pyramids of Giza built for Cheops, Chephren, and Mycerinus, along with the mysterious Great Sphinx of Giza. Transfer back to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Luxor East Bank
itinerary.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. Transfer to Cairo International Airport for your flight to Luxor.
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to board your Nile River cruise ship. Visit the magnificent Luxor Temple dedicated to the god Amun, followed by the impressive Karnak Temple Complex. Explore the famous Great Hypostyle Hall with its giant columns before returning to the cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Luxor West Bank & Edfu
itinerary.text: Breakfast on board the cruise. Visit the famous Valley of the Kings, explore the impressive Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut, and stop at the Colossi of Memnon. Return to your Nile River cruise ship and sail to Edfu. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Edfu & Kom Ombo
itinerary.text: Breakfast on board the cruise. Visit the Temple of Edfu, one of the best-preserved temples in Egypt. Continue to the Temple of Kom Ombo dedicated to Sobek and Haroeris, then sail to Aswan. Overnight on board the Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Aswan Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Breakfast on board the cruise. Visit the impressive Aswan High Dam, continue to the ancient Unfinished Obelisk, and explore the beautiful Philae Temple dedicated to the goddess Isis. Return to your Nile River cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise

itinerary.title: Aswan Flight to Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast on board the cruise followed by disembarkation from your Nile River cruise ship. Enjoy a traditional felucca ride around Elephantine Island and visit Kitchener's Island with its beautiful botanical gardens. Later, transfer to Aswan International Airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Grand Egyptian Museum & Old Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Visit the Grand Egyptian Museum before continuing to the historic Cairo Citadel and the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Explore Old Cairo and visit the Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church and the Hanging Church. Later, enjoy free time at the famous Khan el-Khalili bazaar before returning to the hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Departure from Cairo
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Cairo Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 9-Day Egypt Trip Including Luxor & Aswan?
faqs.a: The 9-Day Egypt Trip Including Luxor & Aswan covers Cairo, Luxor, and Aswan, along with a 4-night Nile Cruise. You will visit the Pyramids of Giza, explore the treasures of ancient Cairo, discover Luxor's magnificent temples and royal tombs, and experience the beauty of Aswan while sailing along the legendary Nile River. The tour runs for 8 nights and 9 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 9-Day Egypt Trip Including Luxor & Aswan cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,995 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes hotel accommodation, a 4-night Nile Cruise, two domestic flights, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees according to the itinerary, selected meals, and all airport, hotel, and cruise transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and accommodation category.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes two domestic flights within Egypt. These flights provide a convenient way to travel between Cairo and Upper Egypt, maximizing your sightseeing time and comfort.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in Cairo hotels and a 4-night Nile Cruise between Luxor and Aswan. Daily breakfast is included at the hotels, while full-board meals are generally provided onboard the Nile Cruise according to the cruise schedule.

faqs.q: Does the 9-day Egypt tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking Egyptologist guides accompany all scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will explain the history, mythology, and significance of Egypt's ancient monuments throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors who want a more in-depth experience of Egypt. The extended Nile Cruise allows additional time to explore ancient temples, historic sites, and local culture while enjoying one of the world's most famous rivers.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, temples, museums, and cruise ports. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the itinerary.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Cairo, Luxor, Aswan, and the Nile Cruise?
faqs.a: Cairo is famous for the Pyramids of Giza, the Sphinx, and the Egyptian Museum. Luxor features the Valley of the Kings, Karnak Temple, and Luxor Temple. Aswan is known for the Philae Temple, High Dam, and Nubian culture. The 4-night Nile Cruise offers scenic sailing and visits to some of Egypt's most impressive ancient temples along the Nile.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 9-Day Egypt Trip Including Luxor & Aswan?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 90 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 90 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, cruise conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection

faqs.q: Can the 9-Day Egypt Trip Including Luxor & Aswan be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add Abu Simbel, extend your stay in Cairo, upgrade hotel or cruise categories, include a Red Sea beach extension, or modify the itinerary. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
